
/**
 * AUTO GENERATED SCRAPE FILE
 * Request by : 6289673462138@s.whatsapp.net
 * Filename   : puisi.txt
 * Upload At  : Sabtu, 15/11/2025
 */

const axios = require('axios')
const cheerio = require('cheerio')

async function puisi() {
  try {
    const url = 'https://karyakarsa.com/sigota/kumpulan-puisi-random-2'
    const { data } = await axios.get(url)
    const $ = cheerio.load(data)

    const puisiList = []

    $('.content-lock p').each((i, el) => {
      const text = $(el).text().trim()
      if (text) puisiList.push(text)
    })

    const puisiFormatted = []
    let current = []

    for (const line of puisiList) {
      if (line === '-----------') {
        if (current.length) {
          puisiFormatted.push(current)
          current = []
        }
      } else {
        current.push(line)
      }
    }

    if (current.length) puisiFormatted.push(current)

    if (puisiFormatted.length === 0) {
      return {
        code: 404,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        message: 'Tidak ada puisi ditemukan'
      }
    }

    const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * puisiFormatted.length)
    const randomPuisi = puisiFormatted[randomIndex].join('\n')

    return {
      code: 200,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      data: randomPuisi
    }

  } catch (e) {
    return {
      code: 500,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      message: e.message
    }
  }
}

;(async () => {
  return await puisi()
})()
